audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Teemo five of the seven rows — including 2+ items at 2/10 — against a 55.36% Ornn win rate over 2119 games, and against its own why text. whys[2] says Ornn trades back from 3, whys[3]/[4] describe Ornn punishing and catching him, whys[5] says Ornn tanks his poke, and whys[6] says outright 'He doesn't out-scale you'.
audit.why: Teemo's lane strength is real but front-loaded: Blinding Dart plus Toxic Shot chip at levels 1-2. From level 3 the blind stops answering Ornn, because it only blinds basic attacks, and Teemo has no dash to escape the E-into-pillar knock-up. The packet chart reads it the same way.
audit.corrected: Level 3 -> Skill, Levels 4-5 -> Ornn, Level 6 -> Ornn, first item -> Ornn, 2+ items -> Ornn, with ratings raised off 2/10. Matched full/content pairs, one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked as Teemo's and said only that 'Teemo's ultimate changes the math'. Noxious Trap was never described.
audit.why: Noxious Trap is a stored-charge zoning tool with a 0.25s cast cooldown and 600/750/900 throw range — it is map control and vision denial, not a duelling spike. Level 6 in a straight lane belongs to Ornn, whose R catches a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten; mushroom threat repositioned to the 2+ item row where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single fact that decides this lane was never stated plainly: Blinding Dart blinds basic attacks only. The page said 'Blinds your autos. E-knock up instead' in one line and then built five level-chart rows as though the blind shut Ornn down entirely.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.' Blind affects attacks. Volcanic Rupture, Bellows Breath, Searing Charge and Call of the Forge God all function normally, and per the mirror audit, Brittle is applied by Bellows Breath — an ability — so the blind does not stop the Brittle setup either. Blinding Dart is also 7s flat at every rank and costs 70-90 mana.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[2].why, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Stack pure HP vs %damage' was listed as a mistake with no explanation, and nothing on the page said which resistance to buy.
audit.why: The flagged missing interaction applies: Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage applied by every auto and scaling with attack speed, which is exactly what Element of Surprise gives him after he leaves invisibility. Armour reads that trade wrong.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states on-hit magic damage and points at MR.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Teemo must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bellows Breath arrives and Blinding Dart does nothing to it — blind stops attacks, not abilities. You can finally trade back.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Punish his step-ups: Q the pillar behind him, then E into it. Blinding Dart is 7s flat and costs 70 mana — he cannot spam it forever.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Teemo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Noxious Trap is map control, not a duel tool. Teemo has no dash, so R into E off the pillar catches him — and blind never touches either of them.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blinding Dart's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first health item eats Toxic Shot's on-hit ticks, and his chip stops mattering at all.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Teemo carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Teemo does not out-scale you — his threat becomes mushroom vision at chokes, not the duel. Q-wall his escape when you catch him.

edits.before: Blinds your autos. E-knock up instead. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 7s flat, 680 range, and it blinds attacks only — your Q, W, E and R all land.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage that scales with his attack speed — buy magic resist, not armour.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Blinds your autos. E-knock up instead. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Blinding Dart stops basic attacks, nothing else — Brittle from Bellows Breath still lands through it.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos. E-knock up instead. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: 7s flat at every rank, 680 range, and it blinds attacks only — your abilities are untouched. - Move Quick: 14s, his only escape. - Noxious Trap: stored charges, so treat every bush as trapped.

notes: The full layer still carries diffRating 8.5/10 and report[14] 'Hard matchup' on a lane Ornn wins 55.36% of the time over 2119 games, and breakdown.carry/difficulty repeat 8.5/10. I did not touch those because they appear in five coupled strings and the rating scale's direction is not documented anywhere I can verify — see the question I recorded. The content layer for this matchup is written in FIRST PERSON ('I have no shield', 'Levels 4-6 are where I take over') across early, mid and late, unlike every other Ornn matchup I audited, which uses second person. That is a voice defect worth a sweep. UNVERIFIED and untouched: the 'unstoppable shielded' description of Bellows Breath; per the mirror, Brittle's actual effect on the target is also unconfirmed from the kits.
